progress_checkpoint_004.result: BehaviorCompiler now distinguishes EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE records and independently closed executable entrypoints. SemanticExecutor executes only compiler-approved IR against ReferenceBattleState and ExecutionContext, with strict rejection of non-executable operations.
progress_checkpoint_004.next_distinguishing_work: Build a canonical Modifier definition/catalog join before promoting ADD_MODIFIER; do not mark a source modifier executable solely because its name is known.

progress_checkpoint_005.result: Built a 144-definition catalog from canonical Modifier records carrying explicit source Stacking values. ADD_MODIFIER is executable only for a simple name+target call whose named definition exists in this catalog; append/refresh remains TO_BE_ADDED until a later lifecycle activation boundary.
progress_checkpoint_005.next_distinguishing_work: Promote REMOVE_MODIFIER only if the selected mark-destroy boundary can retain its cleanup/event ordering as explicit pending state; do not immediately erase an instance.

progress_checkpoint_006.result: REMOVE_MODIFIER with an explicit name and target lowers to named mark-destroy transitions. It intentionally does not call dirty removal, so callback/property cleanup ownership remains observable for later lifecycle/event integration.
progress_checkpoint_006.next_distinguishing_work: Build generic DAMAGE_REQUEST reference execution using the selected damage/survival packets while requiring explicit attacker stats and multiplier context; do not infer a damage formula from the request shape alone.

progress_checkpoint_007.result: BehaviorCompiler and SemanticExecutor lower only a standalone ordinary DamageRequest with an explicit DamagePercentage, selected ByAttack/ByMaxHP/ByDefence formula, explicit target multiplier context and shield-before-HP survival commit. Mixed state fields, including StanceValue, StanceDamageType, SPHitRatio, direct-value, Break/SuperBreak and non-normal attack types, remain explicit BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET diagnostics rather than a partial/no-op transition.
progress_checkpoint_007.next_distinguishing_work: DAMAGE-TOUGHNESS-INTEGRATION-001: commit normal HP and StanceValue as one selected request boundary only with explicit per-target toughness/weakness/break inputs; then execute a source-backed normal Avatar or Monster request.

progress_checkpoint_008.result: Selected normal DamageRequest forms may now carry StanceValue in the same executor transition as HP damage. The executor requires explicit per-target ToughnessCommitContext and ToughnessState, applies ordinary shield-before-HP first, then toughness reduction and selected Break damage on zero crossing. SPHitRatio, direct-value, DoT/Break request families and inheritance stay rejected.
progress_checkpoint_008.next_distinguishing_work: TOUGHNESS-OPERATION-BRIDGE-001: classify the eight canonical MODIFY_TOUGHNESS payloads and lower only a shape whose target/value/weakness/break inputs are complete under the same runtime context.

progress_checkpoint_009.result: Corrected the canonical mapping of RPG.GameCore.StackWeakness from MODIFY_TOUGHNESS to MODIFY_WEAKNESS. The selected Attach/WeakList shape now writes an immutable entity weakness set with stable de-duplication. Reference PredicateContext reads that same state for ByHasStanceWeak. Seven reviewed complete Modifier callbacks become EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE; the complete MCommon_WeakType_Fire OnStack callback is source-backed executed.
progress_checkpoint_009.next_distinguishing_work: WEAKNESS-DAMAGE-CONTEXT-INTEGRATION-001: allow selected StanceValue resolution to read the explicit entity weakness state only when the context requests state-derived eligibility; no implicit default weakness or elemental scaling is allowed.

progress_checkpoint_010.result: ToughnessCommitContext now distinguishes explicit weakness eligibility from state-derived eligibility. When unset, selected StanceValue requests read the target RuntimeEntity weakness set using the canonical DamageType/StanceDamageType; absent matching weakness yields a deterministic TOUGHNESS_SKIPPED transition, never an inferred default. Toughness, Break Effect and elemental scaling remain required context inputs.
progress_checkpoint_010.next_distinguishing_work: RESOURCE-EXECUTION-BRIDGE-001: classify the five ModifySPNew AddRatio/AddValue payloads and bind only their selected ordinary team-SP holder/mutation/clamp model.

progress_checkpoint_011.result: BehaviorCompiler now lowers only exact one-field ModifySPNew AddRatio/AddValue payloads to EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE. SemanticExecutor resolves the canonical entity alias solely to its team, writes a bounded shared TeamSkillPointState, evaluates values through the unified DynamicValue resolver, and makes a non-positive contribution a no-op rather than a signed spend. This closes a prior eligibility drift: MODIFY_TEAM_SP was capable of making an entrypoint executable without an executor handler.
progress_checkpoint_011.next_distinguishing_work: EXECUTOR-HANDLER-ELIGIBILITY-AUDIT-001: mechanically compare every EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE IR kind with SemanticExecutor dispatch and required context. Only then choose the highest eligible BOUND_UNEXECUTABLE_PACKET family by coverage gain and evidence closure.

progress_checkpoint_012.result: A generated audit compares every compiled EXECUTABLE_REFERENCE operation kind to SemanticExecutor's declared handler/context contract. All 1,290 operations before the next modifier expansion passed; the former ModifySPNew eligibility/handler drift is no longer possible under the audit test.
progress_checkpoint_012.next_distinguishing_work: MODIFIER-DYNAMIC-INITIALIZATION-001: admit only explicit catalog-backed AddModifier DynamicValues and preserve rather than discard their per-instance values.

progress_checkpoint_013.result: Selected AddModifier {ModifierName, DynamicValues} payloads evaluate all values through the unified resolver and persist named Decimal values on pending/refresh ModifierInstance state. ExecutionContext now carries ParamEntity dispatch context, proving a real StageAbility_3001213 listener's nested predicate/add transition. Chance, lifetime, layer overrides and later instance-identity lookup remain explicit blockers.
progress_checkpoint_013.next_distinguishing_work: DOT-DAMAGE-EXECUTION-BRIDGE-001: lower only explicit AttackType=DOT DamagePercentage forms to a separate no-crit tick commit; direct value, Break, inheritance, apply/refresh/expiry remain excluded.

progress_checkpoint_014.result: BehaviorCompiler and SemanticExecutor now lower only selected AttackType=DOT DamagePercentage requests through a separate no-crit damage path, retaining the existing universal/DEF/RES/vulnerability and shield-before-HP transition. A real Black Swan MAvatar_BlackSwan_00_DOT OnPhase1 canonical operation component executes as DOT_DAMAGE_COMMITTED. DoT application, chance, refresh, stack, expiry, scheduling, Break, direct-value and inherited/mixed forms remain strict rejections.
progress_checkpoint_014.next_distinguishing_work: SET-DYNAMIC-VALUE-CROSS-TARGET-001: aggregate only the remaining unexecutable SET_DYNAMIC_VALUE payload shapes, identify whether an exact read/write target resolver model is uniquely source-supported, and admit no shape that cannot preserve explicit scope/target semantics.

progress_checkpoint_015.result: Selected SetDynamicValueByModifierValue ReadTargetType=ModifierOwnerEntity, ValueType=Layer and Multiplier payloads now execute through an explicit callback ModifierInstance identity. Layer is a separately proven runtime state leaf and is never substituted with Count. Twenty-two canonical operations lower; a real Black Swan DOT OnCustomEvent component writes Dot_Layer_Count through the generic compiler/executor.
progress_checkpoint_015.next_distinguishing_work: DYNAMICVALUE-PROPERTY-MAXHP-READ-001: lower only ReadTargetType=ModifierOwnerEntity/Value=MaxHP SetDynamicValueByProperty forms against immutable SurvivalState.max_hp; exclude all general stat materialization and other aliases.

progress_checkpoint_016.result: Selected SetDynamicValueByProperty ModifierOwnerEntity/MaxHP payloads now read RuntimeEntity.survival.max_hp and synchronously write the selected DynamicValue scope. Six canonical operations lower. A real MCommon_Element_Bleed OnCreate component executes through the generic compiler/executor. All other properties, aliases and contribution materialization remain rejected.
progress_checkpoint_016.next_distinguishing_work: MODIFIER-LOCAL-DYNAMIC-VALUE-MUTATION-001: select only targetless {DynamicKey, ModifierName, NewValue} SetModifierDynamicValue overwrites with one uniquely live named modifier on ModifierOwnerEntity; retain Add/targeted forms as separate blockers.

progress_checkpoint_017.result: Targetless SetModifierDynamicValue payloads with exactly DynamicKey, ModifierName and NewValue now update one uniquely ALIVE named ModifierInstance-local dynamic value on ModifierOwnerEntity. The immutable transition preserves other local values and instance order; ModifyFunction=Add, explicit target, pending/removed, missing and ambiguous forms remain rejected. A real MCommon_Windfury OnBeforeSkillCost component executes through the generic compiler/executor.
progress_checkpoint_017.next_distinguishing_work: ADD-MODIFIER-CATALOG-CLOSURE-001: partition the 218 remaining AddModifier operations by explicit catalog definition, exact target alias and argument shape. Select only one high-frequency branch with existing pending lifecycle semantics; catalog-missing/global/default stacking forms stay rejected.

progress_checkpoint_018.result: Targetless argument-free RemoveSelfModifier callbacks now resolve only the explicit ALIVE callback ModifierInstance, mark it TO_BE_REMOVED and retain callback/property ownership for later dirty cleanup. Twenty-two operation nodes lower, promoting three full Modifier records and five independently executable entrypoints. progress_checkpoint_018.next_distinguishing_work: ADD-MODIFIER-ALIVE-ONLY-FALSE-001: lower only catalog-resolvable {ModifierName, AliveOnly=false} AddModifier forms on ModifierOwnerEntity; true AliveOnly, chance, lifetime, layer, global and unresolved-definition variants remain separate blockers.

The explicit false flag is retained in the execution trace rather than silently ignored. A real MAvatar_BlackSwan_00_DOT OnPhase1 component adds M_BlackSwan_00_ForbidEffectFlag as TO_BE_ADDED. The branch does not select a dead-target policy or support true AliveOnly, chance, lifetime, layer, inheritance, global lookup or catalog-missing forms.
